def shuffled(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return the elements of xs in a shuffled order that depends only on seed."""
    pre seed >= 0
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    post sorted(out) == sorted(xs)
    ex shuffled([], 3) == []
    ex shuffled([1, 2, 3], 7) == shuffled([1, 2, 3], 7)
    ex sorted(shuffled([1, 2, 3], 7)) == [1, 2, 3]
    res: list[int] = []
    for x in xs:
        res.append(x)
    n = res.len()
    state = seed % 2147483648
    for k in range(1, n):
        i = n - k
        state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
        j = state % (i + 1)
        tmp = res[i]
        res[i] = res[j]
        res[j] = tmp
    return res
